also_accepts.handshake: initialize (no MCP-Protocol-Version header needed on initialize), then notifications/initialized, answered 202
also_accepts.headers: After initialize, send MCP-Protocol-Version with the negotiated version. Mcp-Method, Mcp-Name and params._meta are not required on this path. A request with no MCP-Protocol-Version header and no params._meta protocolVersion claim is also served on this path (2025-03-26 clients never send the header).
also_accepts.note: Same tool, evaluator, Preview grants and quotas as the 2026-07-28 path.
also_accepts.sessions: No Mcp-Session-Id is issued; the server is stateless.

note: public_access.enabled is true on this process (see /.well-known/exactlane.json). tools/call / check_mcp_capability still requires the documented handshake and Preview grant issuance. Discovery (server/discover, tools/list) may still work without a Preview grant. Clients must read /.well-known/exactlane.json.
